title: Chapter 6 Revision: Home & City
description: Mixed questions covering locative case, locative adjectives, prepositions of place, locative plural, and home/city vocabulary.

questions.explanation: 'Dom' → locative 'domu'. Position = 'w + locative': w domu = at home.

questions.prompt: Pracuje ___ Polsce. (She works in Poland.) [Polska → locative]
questions.explanation: Countries use 'w + locative': w Polsce = in Poland. 'Polska' → locative 'Polsce'.

questions.prompt: Mieszkam w ___ mieszkaniu. (I live in a small flat.) [mały → n locative]
questions.explanation: 'Mieszkanie' is neuter; adjective locative for m/n = -ym: 'małym mieszkaniu'.

questions.prompt: Ona pracuje w ___ firmie. (She works in a big company.) [duży → f locative]
questions.explanation: 'Firma' is feminine; adjective locative for feminine = -ej: 'dużej firmie'.

questions.prompt: Idę ___ sklepu. (I'm going from the shop.) [movement away]
questions.explanation: 'Ze/z + genitive' = from. 'Ze sklepu' = from the shop. (Ze used before sklep's consonant cluster).

questions.prompt: Książka leży ___ stole. (The book is lying on the table.) [position]
questions.explanation: 'Na + locative' for position on a surface: 'na stole' = on the table.
Locative plural: all nouns take -ach. 'Miasto' → 'miastach'. 'W miastach' = in cities.
'Rynek' = market square / town square. 'Na rynku' = in/at the market square (locative).

questions.prompt: Pracuję w ___ sklepach. (I work in big shops.) [duży → adj loc pl]
questions.explanation: Adjective locative plural = -ych (hard stems): 'dużych'. 'W dużych sklepach' = in big shops.
'Obok' = next to / beside (+ genitive). 'Bank jest obok poczty' = The bank is next to the post office.

questions.prompt: Dzieci bawią się ___ ulicy. (Children play in the streets.) [ulica → loc pl]
questions.explanation: 'Ulica' → locative plural 'ulicach'. 'Na ulicach' = on/in the streets. Streets use 'na' not 'w'.
